name: content-ppt-pipeline
description: An evidence-led PowerPoint workflow with equal execution support for ChatGPT with CCM and Codex native runtime; CPA provides optional per-page visual generation.

interface.longDescription: Run PowerPoint projects using ChatGPT with CCM or Codex native runtime as peer execution routes; close narrative and evidence gaps, maintain canonical specs and stage-scoped page states, generate independent visuals through fresh CPA requests, review composition before editable reconstruction, and validate editable PowerPoint and whole-deck output.
defaultPrompt: Use Content PPT Pipeline to turn my material into a content-heavy presentation.
Use Content PPT Pipeline to review and continue this technical PowerPoint project.
